label: SafetyComplianceOrchestration process: Verify customer safety compliance status — Cross-reference customer accounts and campaigns against safety compliance records to ensure contractual safety obligations are met.

args.content:
## Landscape Summary
- 11 systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

## ⭐⭐⭐ CUSTOMER SAFETY COMPLIANCE VERIFICATION
- **sap.ehs:agent:ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator:v1** - BEST FOR CUSTOMER SAFETY COMPLIANCE: Automates safety compliance campaigns across customer segments and accounts; monitors campaign effectiveness; coordinates regulatory compliance initiatives; orchestrates targeted safety interventions based on customer account risk profiles; related entity types: Campaign, CustomerAccount, CustomerSegment; capabilities: compliance-automation, incident-prevention, regulatory-enforcement

## ⭐⭐⭐ EQUIPMENT MAINTENANCE SAFETY RISK ANALYSIS
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1** - BEST FOR EQUIPMENT MAINTENANCE SAFETY: Coordinates safety incident workflows & emergency response; related entity types: ChangeRequest, ITEquipment, ServiceTicket; tracks equipment status during incidents; routes to response teams; ensures compliance with regulatory timelines; integrates with change management to identify equipment-related safety risks from maintenance schedules/change requests

## ⭐⭐⭐ PROCUREMENT & INVOICE ANALYSIS FOR COST OPTIMIZATION
- **sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceInvoiceAutomation:v1** - BEST FOR PROCUREMENT METRICS ANALYSIS: Validates supplier invoices against POs & contracts; detects billing anomalies, overages, repeated submissions; identifies cost-saving opportunities; mitigates procurement risk; related entity types: Contract, PurchaseOrder, Vendor; tags: invoice-verification, procurement-validation

## ⭐⭐⭐ HAZARD DUTY COMPENSATION & PAY ADJUSTMENTS
- **sap.sf:agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1** - BEST FOR HAZARD DUTY PAY: Automates compensation policy enforcement and processes salary adjustments based on organizational rules; monitors compensation changes across workforce; coordinates policy-driven salary adjustments for employee lifecycle transitions & market adjustments; enforces compliance with compensation policies & payroll regulations; related entity types: Compensation, Employee

## ⭐⭐⭐ WORKFORCE CAPACITY & SKILL ALLOCATION
- **sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1** - BEST FOR WORKFORCE PLANNING: Coordinates optimal resource allocation; automates matching of personnel skills to organizational needs; facilitates dynamic workforce planning; continuously evaluates capability gaps; recommends targeted development/reassignment actions; related entity types: EngineeringChange, Material, ProductItem; capabilities: workforce-optimization, capability-planning, resource-orchestration

## ⭐⭐⭐ EMPLOYEE SAFETY CERTIFICATION & TRAINING VERIFICATION
- **sap.sf:agent:OccupationalSafetyComplianceMonitor:v1** - Monitors and automates occupational safety incident tracking and hazard compliance; coordinates real-time monitoring of hazardous substances and safety incidents across workforce; automates compliance verification workflows; processes incident reports to ensure organizational adherence to occupational safety regulations; triggers corrective actions based on incident severity and hazard classifications; related entity types: HazardousSubstance, Incident, SafetyIncident

## INCIDENT ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS ⭐⭐
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Analyzes safety incidents to identify root causes; generates RCA reports with recommended corrective/preventive actions; prioritized by risk severity; related entity types: SafetyIncident, Incident, HazardousSubstance

## PROCUREMENT & VENDOR SPECIFICATIONS ⭐⭐⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1** - Retrieves vendor & material specifications; exposes PurchaseOrder & Vendor entity types; capabilities: "coordinate-vendor-procurement", "validate-purchase-orders", "verify-vendor-compliance"; supports certified vendor data retrieval for BOM validation; part of proc_ProductComplianceManufacturing_v1

## ⭐ ENGINEERING CHANGE INITIATION & CAPTURE
- **siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1** - Initiates engineering changes; automates approval workflows; synchronizes configuration updates; coordinates engineering changes across product items & materials; has explicit capability "initiate-engineering-change"; best for capturing & validating new product specifications

## CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT & PRODUCTION TRANSITION ⭐⭐⭐
- **emarsys.cx:agent:ProductLifecycleOrchestrator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes & material updates; triggers coordinated customer engagement campaigns; orchestrates targeted sales communications to affected customer segment
